name: Death Titan
primary:
A giant death titan rises waist-deep from the ground at the aimed spot and fights from there while you keep the channel.
Ultimate channel: just stand still for up to 12 s. Stepping aside breaks the channel and the titan sinks back underground; instant mode does not apply. Needs open sky above the aimed spot.
It picks foes within 20 blocks and, about every 1.5 s, either drains life with a ray: damage 3 ❤ death, life drain 1.5 ❤, withering; heals you by 1 ❤;
or slams the ground with both fists, which releases a soul nova; everyone within 5 blocks takes 4 ❤ death and strong withering.
self_description:
On you:
• Stone skin (resistance II), 15 s
• Withering, 2 s
